observations: Source-stream loss occurs later in the blend than direct cancellation, so the body is already raised farther. It returns to ragdoll and settles; restarting both action streams does not recreate the retired attachment.
limitations: The body is raised by an experimental pose blend while the carrier is already in a loaded pose; this is not a complete lifting performance.
Contacts, exact floor settling, arbitrary cancellation times and other body types are not accepted.
